2741-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.

2741-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

2595-4694-5686-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-4694-5686-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a permanent that is boosting the toughness of all your creatures by at least 1, or that is giving a creature a +1/+1 counter as it enters the battlefield.
You control at least one additional creature.
2595-4694-5686-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
The Blood token enters the battlefield as a 0/0 creature due to March of the Machines, and will have its toughness boosted by the permanent specified in the pre-requisites to prevent it from dying.
Repeat.

767-2113-4687.notablePrerequisites: Druids' Repository has at least four counters on it.
767-2113-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Druids' Repository.
Activate Druids' Repository as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Druids' Repository, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

3305-3899-4022-4772-5926.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that are 1/1 Insects.
Put all but one of the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, each Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and each Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve both Hidden Herbalist triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger.
Resolve the Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

You control another nonland creature.

Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Thermopod from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Thermopod is still in your graveyard.

Repeat each combat phase.
